title: Now the questions appear
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: a backlog of requests traced up to the decisions and goals they serve, or to nothing; goals traced down to decisions, questions and measures; each measure defined once, given a home on the map and an owner; and data products scoped by capability and domain, not by request.
howto: Paper on a wall is a draft or a request; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Purple is motivation, where goals live; amber is strategy, where capabilities live; yellow is the business layer, where decisions are made; peach is information, where questions and measures live. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
